Trading risk and enquiry privacy

Please read the following before using this website and third-party platforms.

Content & service scope

This website introduces group businesses, strategy research and related services. It does not constitute individualized advice, a return guarantee or a trading mandate. Specific services, fees, providers and regions are subject to actual discussions and agreements.

Trading risk

FX, gold and other leveraged trading may result in loss of part or all of the capital invested. Volatility, liquidity, slippage and system failures affect outcomes. Automation, hedging and stops do not eliminate loss risk.

Historical data & sources

Past performance does not predict future results. Historical snapshots identify their dates and sources. Consult original records for periods, fees and verification scope. A reference does not imply third-party endorsement.

Enquiry information & privacy

The enquiry tool prepares content in the current page and does not automatically submit it to the team. Refreshing or closing the page clears unsaved content. Copying places content on your device clipboard. Information sent through WhatsApp, WeChat or other sites is subject to their privacy policies. Hosting services may retain basic access logs. This site does not deploy advertising trackers or analytics scripts.
